observation.command: CH="test-code-verifier"; curl -sL -H 'Host: auth.localhost' "http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=frontend&response_type=code&scope=openid&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/auth/callback&code_challenge_method=S256&code_challenge=$(echo -n $CH | base64 -w0 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=')" -o /tmp/kc2.html -w "final: %{http_code}\n"; grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/kc2.html | head -1; grep -oiE 'id="(username|password)"' /tmp/kc2.html | sort -u; grep -oE 'login-logo[^>]*' /tmp/kc2.html | head -2
